authority: Registered House Tang development packages. Mutable project state remains in House Tang, Sword Manor force, treasury, population, runtime and candidate-pool owners.

sword_manor_expansion.rule: Existing built capacity is used before new construction. If physical capacity becomes the binding intake constraint, House Tang may start the appropriate registered shared infrastructure project using exact House treasury silver, local construction materials, conserved construction labor, finite Sword Manor land and shared calendar-time physics. No House-only package price or magic capacity grant exists.

sword_manor_operating_costs.rule: Sword Manor is part of House Tang permanent military population; operating cost and food burden scale from current conserved troops across all four ranks, not from authorized empty positions.
